text:
rhea: urgent: we're seeing a KV cache degradation causing embed misses for EU customers. cutting emergency hotfix v2.3.11. target short window 02:00-02:15 UTC. requesting expedited approval to skip canary because multiple paying customers are affected. details: https://confluence/release/v2.3.11 (root)
deploybot: Deploybot: preflight checks passed (unit+smoke). Canary-skip requires 2 release:approve approvers, one must be oncall.
omar: what's the precise rollback plan if we see regression? also need a one-line note for support.
rhea: rollback plan: immediate image pin to last-known-good sha lmn222, traffic cut via rr-turndown, no DB changes. auto-rollback if 5m error rate > 2% or p99 > 2s. commands:```sh
# rollback
kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=image:lmn222 -n prod-eu
deploybot rollback --thread 7077777777 --reason "auto-rollback"
```
ops-oncall: eu-west1 spare capacity confirmed, i'll be on the thread and monitoring. +1
kelly: i'm oncall and will watch dashboards. +1 from me. :thumbsup:
omar: OK from infra, +1. leaving a short release note suggestion.
rhea: added release note: "v2.3.11 — emergency kv-cache fix to reduce embed misses; rolling EU 02:00-02:15 UTC; no schema changes." link: https://docs/releases/v2.3.11-notes
deploybot: Deploybot: Approval count 3 (rhea, ops-oncall, kelly). Initiating gated rollout in 2m. streaming logs: https://deploylogs/7077777777
deploybot: Phase 1 (20% traffic) -> OK. No error uplift.
ops-oncall: running sanity probe now: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://api.eu1.redwood/sanity -d '{}'` -> 200
deploybot: Phase 2 (60% traffic) -> OK. Metrics: kv-hit-rate +78% vs pre. p99 stable.
kelly: monitoring p50/p99 and error-rate; no spikes.
deploybot: Phase 3 (100%) -> Completed. No sustained regressions.
omar: quick follow-up probe returned 200 and traces look clean. good work.
rhea: closing rollout, tagging support + product to publish the note and filing a short follow-up doc. :tada:
thread_summary: Emergency hotfix v2.3.11 for KV cache degradation in EU. Expedited approvals granted (rhea, ops-oncall, kelly). Canary skipped per approvers. Phased rollout completed with improved kv-hit-rate and no regressions. Rollback plan pinned to sha lmn222 if thresholds hit; support notified.
